title: Wu Changshuo
extract: Wu Changshuo, born Wu Junqing, was a Chinese calligrapher, painter, and seal artist of the late Qing Period. Born in Anji County, Zhejiang Province, he is best known for his achievements in painting, calligraphy, and seal carving. Wu Changshuo excelled at painting flowers—particularly plum blossoms, peonies, and pomegranates. His works are characterized by the use of bold, vivid colors and powerful brushstrokes, which together define his distinctive personal style.
